subject: pathology
title: Coal Workers Pneumoconiosis, Caplan Syndrome, Silicosis, Asbestosis, and Pleural Plaques

steps.tx: Coal workers pneumoconiosis dusts miners' lungs with coal macules around respiratory bronchioles that may coalesce into progressive massive fibrosis, upper lobe masses crippling breathing after decades underground. The dust disease is **coal workers pneumoconiosis (black lung)**. This point is tested repeatedly because it changes everyday bedside decisions.
steps.say: Coal macules coalescing into massive upper lobe fibrosis cripple miners decades after the dust.

vis.caption: Severe coal workers pneumoconiosis with progressive massive fibrosis.

steps.tx: Caplan syndrome crowns rheumatoid arthritis in coal and silica exposed lungs with sudden crops of large necrobiotic nodules, cavitating at pleural surfaces, separating from ordinary progressive fibrosis by tempo and serology. The rheumatoid dust alliance is **Caplan syndrome (rheumatoid pneumoconiosis)**. Examiners return to it because it separates careful clinicians from guesswork.
steps.say: Rheumatoid arthritis plus dust plus sudden large lung nodules equals Caplan syndrome.

steps.tx: Silicosis scars lungs of stone cutters, sandblasters, and miners with concentric hyalinised silicotic nodules favouring upper lobes and hilar nodes whose rims calcify into eggshell patterns. Tuberculosis stalks its scarred tissue: **silicosis with eggshell nodal calcification**. Bedside recognition of this pattern saves time, blood, and unnecessary investigation.
steps.say: Upper lobe silicotic nodules plus eggshell node calcification, and always hunt tuberculosis within.

vis.caption: Silicosis pulmonary pathology with hyalinised nodules and fibrotic progression.

steps.tx: Silica cripples macrophage lysosomes, so inhaled tubercle bacilli find defenceless hosts, making silicotuberculosis a mandatory exclusion at every review with sputum microbiology. That deadly partnership is **silicotuberculosis surveillance in silicosis**. Students should anchor this fact before moving to rarer causes and exceptions.
steps.say: Silica disarms the very macrophages tuberculosis needs killed; sputum testing belongs at every silicosis review.

steps.tx: Asbestosis fibroses lower lobes and parietal pleura after asbestos exposure, its ferruginous bodies, asbestos cores coated in iron protein beads, proving exposure in tissue and lavage. The beaded fibre is the **ferruginous (asbestos) body**. In practice this distinction decides the next test, treatment, or referral made.
steps.say: Ferruginous bodies prove asbestos reached the lung; lower lobe fibrosis plus plaques completes asbestosis.

nodes.label: Lower lobe fibrosis and pleural change

steps.tx: Pleural plaques, discrete hyaline collagen patches on parietal pleura and diaphragm, calcify visibly as exposure receipts usually without symptoms, while diffuse thickening and rounded atelectasis carry functional cost. The benign receipt is **asbestos pleural plaque disease**. That is why this detail earns its place in every examination and ward round.
steps.say: Calcified pleural plaques receipt asbestos exposure; most harm nobody, unlike diffuse pleural thickening.

steps.tx: Exposure histories spanning first jobs, military service, shipyards, sandblasting, and home renovation make pneumoconiosis diagnoses that scans alone only suggest, with latency stretching decades. That detective work is **occupational exposure history in dust lung disease**. Remembering it prevents the commonest errors made with this presentation entirely.
steps.say: Ask about the first job, not the last; pneumoconiosis latency outlives employers and memories.

steps.tx: No drug reverses established pneumoconiosis, so prevention by dust suppression, respirators, exposure limits, surveillance, smoking cessation, and compensation justice carries the entire therapeutic weight. That primacy defines **pneumoconiosis prevention over treatment**. The clinical payoff comes from applying it early, before complications accumulate further.
steps.say: Dust diseases are prevented at the source or never cured; respirators and suppression are their only medicine.

nodes.label: Dust measured and suppressed at source
